name: Bandit Captain
notes: CR 2. Multiattack. Reaction parry. Commands bandit group.
gm_notes: Session 2 road ambush leader. Multiattack: one bonus attack with dagger alongside main attacks. Parry reaction: +3 AC against one melee attack per round. Has information about the road and who has been using it -- a Persuasion DC 14 or Intimidation DC 16 after capture can extract it.
